Irene / Samantha — legal here. A few points and a suggested endorsement template (I attached a short excerpt to paste into the broker request):

1) Additional Insured: Acceptable if the endorsement adds Redwood Inference as Additional Insured for ongoing operations and completed operations, and specifically includes contractual liability.
2) Retroactivity: If the policy is claims-made, we need either (a) the endorsement backdated to the policy retroactive date (2024-01-01) or (b) confirmation that the PL policy will remain in force for at least 2 years after completion of services (extended reporting period) to cover potential late claims. Backdating is better but understood to be a broker discussion.
3) Waiver of Subrogation: We require this if allowed by law. If your broker refuses, please escalate with their reasoning.
4) Wording we prefer: "It is hereby understood and agreed that 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' is included as Additional Insured, subject to the terms and conditions of the policy, with respect to liability arising out of the operations performed by the Named Insured on behalf of Redwood Inference."

If the endorsement will take >10 business days, procurement can issue a conditional PO with milestones, but final activation and payment must wait for the signed endorsement. If QubitEdge needs a shorter funding timeline, let us know and we can discuss a limited exception routed through Legal+Finance.

-Mina
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
